Who Superspace is for
Superspace is built for businesses that turn the spaces they already have into bookable time: photography and content studios, podcast and production studios, rehearsal rooms, meeting rooms, coworking and event spaces, and other flexible, multipurpose rooms.
What you can do with Superspace
Area
What it does
Dashboard
Your day at a glance: bookings, revenue, utilisation, today's calendar and anything that needs attention. See
Understand your dashboard
.
My Spaces
Create and publish the spaces people can book, with photos, hours, rules, add-ons and pricing. See
Create your first space
.
Calendar and Bookings
Accept or decline requests, reschedule or cancel bookings, and block time when a space is unavailable. See
How bookings work
.
POS
Create bookings for walk-in or phone customers and take payment with a payment link or bank transfer. See
What is POS?
.
Equipment
Keep an inventory of your gear and log check-outs and returns. See
Understand the Equipment module
.
Customers and Inbox
See who books with you and reply to guest messages and Showcase inquiries.
Earnings
Track your balance and transactions and withdraw to your bank account.
Reports & Analytics
Revenue, bookings, top spaces and Showcase traffic, on plans that include analytics.
Showcase
Your public booking page, where customers browse your spaces and book. See
What is Superspace Showcase?
.
How it fits together
Everything starts with your spaces. The details you set on a space — photos, description, operating hours, rules, add-ons, price and booking confirmation — are what customers see on your Showcase and what Superspace uses to check availability and calculate prices. Bookings made on your Showcase or at your POS then appear in your calendar, bookings list, customer records and earnings.

You have until…

12 hours after the request.

2 hours before the booking starts, but never less than 30 minutes after the request.

30 minutes after the request, or the start time if that comes first.
